justification: Standard: removes a customer-facing ADG shadow verdict from the intelligence brief, the conveyancing report and their marketing copy.

pre_impl.existing_data: No database change. Stored briefs that already carry a shadow field are hidden by the page, not rewritten.
pre_impl.assumption_mismatch: The shadow verdict claimed an ADG 2-hour sunlight rule protects a neighbouring house; ADG 4A-1 applies to a new apartment building's own apartments and 3F is visual privacy.
pre_impl.new_vs_existing: Removal only: the shadow fetch, its report row, its page section and its copy. No new modules.

falsifiable_check.command: cd frontend-nextjs && node node_modules/jest/bin/jest.js __tests__/app/brief-satellite-parity.test.tsx && cd .. && python -m pytest -q -o addopts= tests/test_conveyancing_truth.py
falsifiable_check.fails_when: The intelligence brief page source renders ShadowDisplay, mentions shadow analysis or says ADG, or the conveyancing report source prints a shadow row or ADG wording.
falsifiable_check.observed_red: Both checks are new source checks that match the removed text exactly; on origin/main the brief page imports ShadowDisplay and the report script defines build_shadow_row, so both fail there. Branch: jest 20 of 20, pytest 60 of 60, tsc 0.

functions.name: build_brief (shadow step)
functions.input: a brief request for any address
functions.output: shadow field marked not available with a plain reason
functions.if_none: the brief carries no shadow result and calls no shadow service at all

break_it.scenario: A stored brief from before this change still has a shadow field.
break_it.what_happens: It must not show the ADG verdict.
break_it.how: the page's generic field list skips the shadow key

break_it.scenario: A conveyancing PDF is generated after deploy.
break_it.what_happens: It must not carry a shadow risk row.
break_it.how: build_shadow_row and the fetch removed; test checks the source

break_it.scenario: An already-paid shadow report is opened.
break_it.what_happens: Its PDF still contains the ADG verdict.
break_it.how: owner decision pending: edit the paid PDF or refund

post_merge.manual_verify: Open an intelligence brief and a conveyancing report after deploy; neither shows a shadow section.
